title: Audit event (C8)
description: One JSON object per line on a dedicated logger/appender shipped to the SIEM. Never contains argument values, tool results, secrets, confirmation codes, TOTP codes, authenticator seeds or otpauth URIs; additionalProperties is false so such fields cannot be added by accident. Target system of broker events is carried in 'server' (mcp-<system>). The serializer must escape control characters, U+2028 and U+2029 in every string value.

clientRequestId.description: X-Request-Id sent by the AI client, recorded by the gateway only (C3). Untrusted, so limited to a log-safe alphabet (CC-031); the gateway drops a value that does not match instead of rejecting the call.

backendUser.description: Account in the target system read by whoami (C4.1, CC-101), for connection_change: the only trace of which account a user connected (CC-117). Same length limit as username. Never a secret. Excluded characters: C0 and C1 control characters and DEL (also TAB, LF, CR), every Unicode format character (\p{Cf}: zero-width characters U+200B..U+200F, U+2060, U+FEFF, soft hyphen, bidirectional controls, Arabic letter mark U+061C, tag characters U+E0000..U+E007F), surrogates, U+2028, U+2029, noncharacters (U+FDD0..U+FDEF, U+FFFE, U+FFFF), the invisible fillers U+034F, U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0, U+2800 and the variation selectors U+FE00..U+FE0F. This is the set of the text hygiene of the README (CC-121), stricter for log fields since 3.0.2 (zero-width, direction marks and tag characters used to pass), so that the line-oriented SIEM format and log viewers cannot be misled (CC-031).

id.description: Resource id as the system knows it (Jira key, GitLab path, index name, page id). Free-form because ids of the five systems use different alphabets (slashes, dots, spaces in some service desks). Excluded characters: C0 and C1 control characters and DEL (also TAB, LF, CR), every Unicode format character (\p{Cf}: zero-width characters U+200B..U+200F, U+2060, U+FEFF, soft hyphen, bidirectional controls, Arabic letter mark U+061C, tag characters U+E0000..U+E007F), surrogates, U+2028, U+2029, noncharacters (U+FDD0..U+FDEF, U+FFFE, U+FFFF), the invisible fillers U+034F, U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0, U+2800 and the variation selectors U+FE00..U+FE0F. This is the set of the text hygiene of the README (CC-121), stricter for log fields since 3.0.2 (zero-width, direction marks and tag characters used to pass), so that the line-oriented SIEM format and log viewers cannot be misled (CC-031). The length limit counts code points; producers should keep ids below 512 characters. Independently of this, the audit JSON serializer must escape every control character and U+2028/U+2029.

parent.description: Parent as <Namespace>::<Type>::<id>, e.g. Jira::Project::ABC (C8 example format). The id part has the same exclusions as resource.id: C0 and C1 control characters and DEL (also TAB, LF, CR), every Unicode format character (\p{Cf}: zero-width characters U+200B..U+200F, U+2060, U+FEFF, soft hyphen, bidirectional controls, Arabic letter mark U+061C, tag characters U+E0000..U+E007F), surrogates, U+2028, U+2029, noncharacters (U+FDD0..U+FDEF, U+FFFE, U+FFFF), the invisible fillers U+034F, U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0, U+2800 and the variation selectors U+FE00..U+FE0F. This is the set of the text hygiene of the README (CC-121), stricter for log fields since 3.0.2 (zero-width, direction marks and tag characters used to pass), so that the line-oriented SIEM format and log viewers cannot be misled (CC-031).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, snake case. Known values: policy_forbid, not_granted, tool_disabled, user_confirmed, user_confirmed_no_preview, confirmation_expired, attempts_exhausted, authenticator_not_registered, authenticator_disabled, superseded, pending_exists, cancelled_by_owner, credential_required, step_up_required, rate_limited, rate_limited_user, rate_limited_client, rate_limited_tool, exchange_denied, system_not_configured, subject_token_invalid, credential_type_mismatch, user_purged, unused_cleanup, definition_changed, tool_not_served, definition_submitted, link_scope, policy_unavailable, policy_error. For event policy_decision or tool_call on a server, credential_type_mismatch means that the type in X-MCP-Credential-Type (sent by the gateway) differs from the type in the server configuration, is missing or is not one of the four types: decision deny, outcome error, errorCode internal_error, the client learns nothing more (CC-166). For rate limits (gateway, CC-156) a refused call or request is recorded as tool_call (a tools/call) or policy_decision (any other MCP request) with decision deny, outcome denied, errorCode rate_limited and reason rate_limited_user, rate_limited_client (the pair user and AI client) or rate_limited_tool (the pair user and tool); the client is not told which limit applied, the administrator is. The gateway may aggregate excess events as for CC-125. For event credential_resolve (broker, gateway): exchange_denied (the IdP refused the token exchange, CC-157, outcome denied) and system_not_configured (the system is not configured in the broker, CC-158, outcome error) and subject_token_invalid (the subject token of a token exchange has the wrong audience, has expired or belongs to another sub than the internal JWT, CC-157, outcome denied). For event connection_change (broker): user_purged (the connection was removed by the offboarding purge, CC-155) and unused_cleanup (the connection was removed because it had not been used for the configured number of days, 180 by default, CC-155). For event virtual_server_change the offboarding purge of the gateway records user_purged for every removed link, and both purges (broker and gateway) emit one admin_change with reason user_purged and outcome ok for every call, also when nothing was removed and for an unknown sub, so that a call of mcp-offboarding always leaves a trace (CC-155). For event confirmation (gateway, CC-094): confirmation_pending is the decision when the pending call is created, and the outcome is one of user_confirmed (code accepted), user_confirmed_no_preview (accepted although the owner did not open the portal preview), confirmation_expired, attempts_exhausted, authenticator_not_registered, authenticator_disabled, code_burned (the retry carried a code of a burned step: confirmation_failed outwards, no attempt spent, not a wrong code, CC-128), cancelled_by_owner (the owner cancelled the pending call in the portal, CC-128; decision deny, errorCode confirmation_cancelled, emitted when the cancel is accepted and again when the cancelled call is retried), pending_exists (a new DESTRUCTIVE call was refused because another one is pending and its preview was opened; errorCode confirmation_blocked, CC-127), superseded (the pending DESTRUCTIVE call was replaced by a newer one of the same user, CC-127; emitted for the older call when the newer is created, and again when the older call is retried); user_declined and preview_not_viewed are not emitted since 3.0.0 (there is no decline, and the preview is optional). For event authenticator (broker, portal, CC-094): authenticator_enrollment_started, authenticator_registered, authenticator_enrollment_failed, authenticator_removed, authenticator_reset_by_admin (outcome ok or denied; the target user is sub), authenticator_seed_missing (the seed of a registered authenticator is gone from the secret store: the registration is reset to none, outcome error, errorCode upstream_unavailable, CC-142), authenticator_disabled (the daily limit of 20 wrong codes in 24 hours switched the authenticator off, CC-126; outcome denied) and, for the check of a code with decision allow or deny, totp_verified, totp_invalid, totp_replayed, totp_locked, totp_disabled, totp_burned (a code of a burned step: replayed for the broker but not a failure and not counted, CC-128), totp_steps_burned (the current codes were invalidated because the owner cancelled a pending operation or a new DESTRUCTIVE operation followed a viewed one, CC-128; outcome ok), totp_not_registered (these carry tool, client and virtualServer from the internal JWT). For event virtual_server_change (gateway, CC-116; before 3.0.0 these were admin_change, CC-107): vs_created, vs_deleted, slug_taken, not_granted, invalid_request, virtual_server_limit, not_found_or_denied, and upstream_unavailable when a store behind the operation is down (the list of tools of a link is not a field of this schema; CC-142). For event connection_change (broker) a failed revocation at the provider is recorded with reason provider_revoke_failed (the connection is deleted anyway, outcome error; CC-142). For tool_call and policy_decision: link_scope (the tool or resource lies outside the virtual server link, decision deny), policy_unavailable (no policy bundle is loaded, so nothing can be decided and the request is refused), policy_error (the policy engine failed on this request) definition_changed (the definition the server presents differs from the approved one, so the tool is hidden and refused with errorCode tool_disabled, CC-133) and tool_not_served (the approved tool is missing from the tools the server serves, so it is hidden and refused with errorCode tool_disabled, CC-161). definition_changed and tool_not_served are recorded on every refused call (not once per read) and when a read finds the difference there is no separate event. A failed read of the server's tools/list is not evidence of either: the gateway keeps its last successful read, and a call that needs a fresh read that fails is refused as upstream_unavailable without a call to the server. On a server policy_forbid is a refusal by policy (a forbid rule or no permit) and not_granted a resource that could not be resolved or has no grant (CC-141). Event admin_change records the administrative changes of the gateway and of the broker. For the registry, with reasons definition_registered (the pipeline registered a manifest and the definition was approved by that call: a READ_ONLY tool, CC-133), definition_submitted (the registration left a new or changed UPDATE or DESTRUCTIVE tool pending approval, CC-133), definition_approved (an administrator approved a pending definition; sub is the administrator and definitionHash the approved hash) and tool_removed (a tool left the registered manifest). For definition_approved the sub is the administrator; for user_purged it is the purged user, and the calling identity (the certificate CN mcp-offboarding) is not a field of this schema. Other reasons are not defined. The vs_* reasons are not emitted with admin_change since 3.0.0. For event authentication it is the rejection code: for the internal JWT (receiver: server, broker) one of the vectors (missing_token, bad_signature, unknown_kid, alg_not_allowed, wrong_issuer, wrong_audience, expired, replayed_jti, service_token_not_allowed, tool_mismatch, invalid_claims, lifetime_too_long, not_yet_valid, request_id_mismatch, tool_missing, tool_not_allowed, test_key_not_allowed, malformed); for the token of the AI client at the gateway (C1, CC-120): missing_token, malformed, bad_signature, unknown_kid, alg_not_allowed, wrong_issuer, wrong_audience, expired, not_yet_valid, invalid_claims, and for infrastructure failures client_certificate_rejected, jwks_unavailable, replay_store_unavailable (the last two with errorCode upstream_unavailable). The gateway also emits authentication for its own admin port (C5 /admin/v1 and /actuator/prometheus, CC-125): client_certificate_rejected for a client certificate that is missing, not from the internal CA, lacks the clientAuth purpose or has a CN that the operation does not allow, and the token reasons above for a BFF token that fails validation (aud mcp-gateway-admin). replay_store_unavailable is emitted only by receivers of the internal JWT (servers through the starter, the broker), never by the gateway. The gateway may aggregate or sample client_certificate_rejected on its admin port (for example one event per source address per minute, or a counter in its metrics) so that a scanner cannot flood the SIEM (CC-125).

argsLength.description: Length in bytes of the serialized arguments; the only trace of arguments allowed in audit.

definitionHash.description: Hash of the tool definition an admin_change concerns (CC-133): for definition_approved the approved hash, for definition_registered the hash of each registered definition (one event per tool), for tool_removed the hash of the removed entry. Together with sub (the administrator) and tool it tells afterwards who approved which definition. Not a secret.

allOf.description: Authenticator events (CC-094) always say how they ended (outcome) and why (reason). The field list stays closed through additionalProperties: there is no field that could carry a code, a seed or an otpauth URI.
Virtual server changes (CC-116) always say how they ended (outcome) and why (reason: vs_created, vs_deleted, slug_taken, not_granted, invalid_request, virtual_server_limit, not_found_or_denied).

Rejected authentication (CC-071, CC-120): emitted by a receiver of the internal JWT (server, broker) and by the gateway for the token of the AI client (C1). Closed list of fields (propertyNames): everything that comes from the claims of the unverified token (sub, username, client, tool, risk, resource, virtualServer, policyRevision, credentialType) is forbidden, and so is any part of the token. Carries the rejection code in reason.
replay_store_unavailable belongs to receivers of the internal JWT (server, broker); the gateway has no replay store for tokens of the AI client (CC-125).
